info.headline: Notify NYC - Trick-or-Streets 2026
info.description:
Notification issued 10-01-2026 at 04:40 PM.
Throughout the month of October, NYC DOT Will be transforming streets around the city into harvest and Halloween-themed interactive pedestrian friendly destinations. Events also include performances, fun activities and live entertainment.
Expect occasional road closures and traffic delays near Trick-or-Street events. For an interactive map and schedule of street closures, visit: https://bit.ly/4yqPS7x
To learn more about Trick-or-Streets, dates, and locations, visit: https://bit.ly/4xWGkjG
